name: Boustead Singapore Limited
summary: Boustead Singapore Limited, an investment holding company, provides energy engineering, real estate, geospatial, and healthcare technology solutions in Singapore, Australia, Malaysia, the United States, Europe, rest of Asia Pacific, North and South America, the Middle East, and Africa.
